subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Gourav was __no good__ than a foolish person.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**good**" in the comparison.
 
• In comparative sentences, "**better**" is the correct form to use.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**no better**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Gourav was no better than a foolish person."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "not good"** – This phrase is not correct as it does not provide a proper comparative structure.
 
• **Option 3: "no best"** – This phrase is incorrect as "best" is the superlative form and does not fit in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "not best"** – This phrase is also incorrect because it lacks proper comparative structure and "best" should be used in superlative form.
